gaps.why: the text does not say what improves (the Demon's Cost? the number of Demons?) nor where the improvement is stored; HearthstoneJSON has no related enchantment record

gaps.span: Costs (1) less for each damage you dealt with spells this turn.
gaps.why: v0.1 history counters count casts/cards, not total damage dealt by spells; a damage sum counter is missing.

gaps.span: Battlecry: Herald {0}. Reduce Deathwing's Cost by ({1}). (Herald to improve!)
gaps.why: Herald has no v0.1 rule; {0}/{1} are runtime placeholders, not constants 0 and 1; Deathwing name relation unresolved.

gaps.span: Return this to hand with any excess damage.
gaps.why: No return-source operation with preserved excess-damage parameter; excess damage timing/calculation unresolved.
FREEZE operation is absent. The missing middle step must happen between damage and summon; these fragments are not an executable whole.

gaps.span: Battlecry: Your opponent's spells cost (1) more next turn.
gaps.why: No NEXT_OPPONENT_TURN duration/window. Negative reduce could express +1, but THIS_TURN or turns=1 would not specify the next opponent turn.

gaps.span: Battlecry: Start a three turn lunar cycle. When the Full Moon rises, your cards cost (1) this game.
gaps.why: v0.1 lacks a lunar phase scheduler, full-moon event and THIS_GAME duration. Do not substitute three arbitrary TURN_END triggers.

gaps.span: After this attacks a minion and survives, deal this minion's Attack damage split among all enemies.
gaps.why: No after-source-minion-attack-and-survives event; text says split but does not explicitly say randomly. Keep attack timing and distribution unresolved.
No negation predicate: card_class PALADIN would invert non-Paladin; enumerating other classes is unsafe for multiclass and unknown classes.

gaps.span: Deathrattle: Put two 8/8 Demons with Taunt and Lifesteal on the bottom of your deck.
gaps.why: SHUFFLE_INTO_DECK has no insertion-position or multiplicity parameter; random shuffling is not bottom insertion. Token identities also unresolved.
No survival predicate at the post-damage timing boundary. The conditional draw is omitted rather than made unconditional.
